environment.description: Same Kubernetes cluster but the migration job pod is deployed via a Helm chart that configures a distroless container with an init container responsible for archive retrieval. The init container uses a custom binary compiled with embedded SRI hashes (SHA-384) for each known migration version, sourced from a signed manifest stored in an OCI artifact registry (ghcr.io/corp/migration-manifests:v2). The init container validates the SHA-384 digest of the downloaded zip against the embedded integrity attribute before writing it to the shared emptyDir volume. If the digest does not match, the init container exits non-zero and the pod fails (restartPolicy: Never). The main migration container only reads from the shared emptyDir volume and has no network access (NetworkPolicy with empty egress rules on label app=migration-runner). Additionally, the pod runs under a RuntimeDefault seccomp profile and the filesystem mount for the extraction target is a separate emptyDir with medium: Memory (tmpfs) limited to 50Mi, preventing path traversal writes outside the tmpfs boundary since the container's root filesystem is read-only (readOnlyRootFilesystem: true).
